title: Ignore.github/copilot-instructions.md
bug_description: As the title stated. I found that When I am with GitHub Copilot in VSCode and use `Generate Agent Instructions` (GitHub Copilot will process a preset prompt, analyze other agent related files (if this repo has) and generate a markdown file in `.github`), the generated files `.github/copilot-instructions.md` will be seen by git. So should we append `.github/copilot-instructions.md` to `.gitignore`? cc @ZainRizvi @huydhn @clee2000
